permission.description:
The app's own IPC surface: every command registered in `tauri::generate_handler!` except the three panel-preview report commands, which have their own permission (`allow-panel-report`) because they are invoked from an arbitrary previewed page rather than from our frontend. Granted to the app's own webviews (`main`, `window-*`) on the local app URL (dev) and on the packaged gateway origin (see capabilities/default.json and desktop::gateway_capability).

The presence of ANY app permission file is what creates the app ACL manifest (`__app-acl__`), which switches tauri's `has_app_acl_manifest` to true, so from here on EVERY app command is ACL-checked on EVERY origin, local included. A command registered in `generate_handler!` but missing from this list is denied everywhere, which is why `acl_tests::app_permissions_match_the_invoke_handler` (src/lib.rs) fails the build when the two drift.

The three report-back commands that the panel URL preview's injected JS calls from the PREVIEWED PAGE (see TITLE_OBSERVER_JS / URL_OBSERVER_JS / webview_get_content in src/panel_preview.rs). Because the caller is arbitrary third-party content, the capability that grants this accepts any remote origin. So this permission is deliberately kept to the smallest possible surface and is granted ONLY on `url-preview-*` webviews (capabilities/panel-preview.json). Never add a command here that does anything other than report the previewed page's own title/URL/text back to the window that opened the preview.
